patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient was brought to the emergency department after an episode of loss of consciousness that occurred 1 hour ago, immediately after micturating. His wife found him unconscious on the bathroom floor. He regained consciousness after about 30 seconds without any confusion or amnesia for the event. No history of urinary incontinence during the event.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No significant past medical or surgical history. Not on any regular medications.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Non-smoker. Drinks alcohol socially. Works as a high school teacher. No recent travel or sick contacts.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies chest pain, palpitations, fevers, headaches, seizures, recent illnesses, or any other neurological symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with an episode of loss of consciousness.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 53-year-old man, and about an hour ago I passed out right after I finished urinating. I was only unconscious for around 30 seconds, came back quickly, and I don’t feel confused or have any memory gaps, and there was no incontinence during the episode.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any scratched or rubbed raw skin, and I don’t recall any open spots or excoriations.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any episodes where I stop breathing or wake up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any injured area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist compared with the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall, dark discoloration, or anything like that from an injury, coughing, or straining.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed urinating more often than usual or producing a larger amount of urine. I just had a normal urination before the brief time I lost consciousness.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t use tobacco or cannabis, and I’m not taking any opioids or stimulants. I drink alcohol socially, but I haven’t used any other drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body (for example, a mole that’s changing, a persistent rash, or a wound that won’t heal)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, rashes, or wounds that won’t heal anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently and no blood coming from my nose.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no rash on my chest, back, or belly.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or ankles?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs—around my calves or ankles, or anywhere else.”
